demos.title: Category cascade
demos.description: One select per level of the tree, growing a rung as each is answered and dropping every rung below when one is changed — the ladder is derived from the chain above it, never remembered, so a stale deep answer cannot survive a shallow change. It is deliberately the same gesture as a 'brand → model' characteristic, because under the owner's navigation model a deep category IS one. Counts per option are a host prop and are unfilled here: no server can currently count a category's children, and an invented number is worse than none.
